column2: The $$総本山$$ where my $$ご主人様$$ resides...
does not exist anywhere on this earth!—
Those were the enigmatic words they left behind before quietly breathing their last.
Although their allies' $$戦力$$ had steadily grown...
the party had completely lost their only lead to the $$総本山$$.
Concluding that gathering information must come first...
they made their way near $$ベギルド$$, the City of $$欲情$$...
Along the arduous road blanketed with blooming daffodils...
they never imagined they would encounter those people again...
